arcSummary: Odile held the gate of a falling province until the granaries were empty, then walked out behind the last wagon. Her banner burned. She has not chosen a new one.

stages.title: The Granary Road
stages.summary: The route crosses the evacuation road she held open. She walks it counting wagons that aren't there.

stages.title: The Scattered
stages.summary: Her province's people resettled in threes and fives across two kingdoms. Word of a cluster ahead — and they still use her title.

stages.title: Colors
stages.summary: The campus gatehouse has an empty banner pole. She has noticed it every day since she arrived.
